title: ISIS claims responsibility for deadly Greek Orthodox church attack in Jordan
description: Warning: Graphic scenes in the videos below. Viewer discretion advised. ( LifeSiteNews ) — Horrifying footage out of Jordan shows the moment that gunmen storm a Greek Orthodox church during a funeral procession, killing seven and injuring as many as 40 more. … Iraqi Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein “affirmed Iraq’s solidarity with Jordan in the face of terrorism. ” U.N. Secretary-General Antonio Guterres condemned the attack as “especially heinous,” and called “for all those responsible to be found and to be held to account.” Three days of national mourning have been proclaimed in Jordan.

title: Leo XIV openly rejects the reign of Christ the King over states and nations
description: Bringing you the news from a traditional Catholic perspective. “Now, this authority, perfect in itself, and plainly meant to be unfettered, so long assailed by a philosophy that truckles to the State, the Church, has never ceased to claim for herself and openly to exercise. The Apostles themselves were the first to uphold it, when, being forbidden by the rulers of the synagogue to preach the Gospel, they courageously answered: ‘We must obey God rather than men.'” … He believes that the Church has no right to “interfere” in the “worldly” affairs of men or impose the moral law. This may be true of the “Synodal Church” of which Leo is the head. But it certainly isn’t true of the Catholic Church founded by Jesus Christ. This Church, infallible and indefectible, remains ever faithful to the mission entrusted to her — to teach the nations with authority and direct men to eternal life. Though she may be temporarily cast into shadow by the actions of evil men, she only awaits the moment prepared by Divine Providence when her voice will be clearly heard by all, proclaiming the Empire of Our Lord.

title: Bishop Strickland: Do You Really Know Jesus—Or Just Know About Him?
description: Bringing you the news from a traditional Catholic perspective. There is a difference between knowing about Jesus Christ and having a personal relationship with Him that transforms your life. The Watchman’s Lamp explores that difference through the story of a Protestant woman who, while facing her husband’s terminal illness, encountered Christ’s presence in a Catholic church and eventually became Catholic.
